scope: Nine real N-by-D row workloads frozen before generation or original/native calls; all gains and losses retained. No image carrier, full-library or prior-C++ gain claim.
independent_oracle: Decode each logical fixed-width row as opaque bytes, sorted(set(rows)) in unsigned byte order, and first occurrence index per exact byte row. Preserve floating raw words including signed zero; do not perform numeric row sorting or NumPy unique.
timed_boundary: Whole public call: contiguous preparation/copy if needed, row view, native byte equality/sort and first indices, literal final NumPy advanced-index gather, allocations and output destruction. Generation, oracle and parity guards are outside timers.
provider_frontier: Final NumPy advanced-index gather remains an explicit dtype/layout transfer provider. Ordinary exact fixed dtype ndarrays only; protocols, objects, exceptional/empty shapes and longdouble padding are outside timing.
